questions.question: Who were all the children of Benjamin Fairbanks Phipps (born 30 January 1816 in Thompson, Windham, Connecticut; died 16 August 1893 in Thompson), including any not recorded in Family Tree?
questions.rationale: The researcher asked for every child of Benjamin Fairbanks Phipps, whether recorded in Family Tree or not. The tree currently lists two children, Charles Patton Phipps and George Fairbanks Phipps, both by Mary L Childs, but no completeness check has been made. The question asks for the full set of children, so any child missing from the tree is found.

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: Plain language for someone who has never done genealogy. No identifiers, file names, tool names or field names. Never write GPS, proof, proved or exhaustive: say genealogy standards; call an answer a conclusion when it is well established and a finding otherwise; say what we searched and what we could not reach. Never sound surer than the evidence was rated: say the records show it for a well established fact or relationship, probably for a likely one and possibly for a tentative one, and never write that someone is the parent, spouse or child of another without one of these. Say match or search result, never hit; never write ARK: name the record or link to it. Do not describe your own instructions or checks. Do not narrate between actions; report once when the step is done: what was found, in one paragraph, and what happens next in one sentence.
